cli.help:
&6CapitalMC
&b/capital gui &7opens the exchange GUI.
&b/capital account create &7registers an account with private chat questions.
&b/capital account login Trader01 &7logs in; enter the password only when privately prompted.
&b/capital account password &7changes your password.
&b/capital markets &7lists trading pair IDs.
&7Balances, deposits, withdrawals, transfers and orders are available in the GUI. Amounts use the displayed asset units; prices are quote asset per 1 base asset.
